Container.Name: ShareDrive-Backend
Container.Overview: ShareDrive API. Build the local sharedrive-backend:unraid image first using the README's Unraid instructions. Requires the sharedrive Docker network and PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO and ClamAV. No backend port is published. The existing .env and Caddyfile must be regular files before applying this template. Startup applies versioned database migrations; baseline legacy db-push installations and back up before upgrades. Runs as UID/GID 1000.

Config.Name: Environment file
Config.Description: Existing .env file. Keep the host path in Extra Parameters (--env-file) in sync if you change this path. The setup wizard writes infrastructure credentials here.

Config.Name: Caddy configuration
Config.Description: Existing writable Caddyfile, also used by the infrastructure stack.

Config.Name: Setup token directory
Config.Description: Private persistent setup token; owner UID/GID 1000, directory 0700 and token 0600.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Internal port expected by nginx; no host port mapping is needed.
